evidence: Diagnostics show 48,362 duplicate user-video rows in training and 3,572 in validation, indicating that users frequently revisit the same videos. The engine also suggested 'duplicate_interaction_ablation' based on this property.
expected_effect: Improve prediction accuracy and overall ranking quality by allowing the model to learn context-specific embeddings for first-time views versus repeated user-video exposures.
hypothesis: Adding the user_video_exposure_bucket operator during the features stage will enable the model to explicitly distinguish between novel and repeated user-video interactions, capturing specific behavioral patterns tied to re-watching.
